what: Platina | Live in Yerevan, stage LIGHT scenes, merged spec (spine design A, grafts from design B)
source: design-A.json + design-B.json judged in design-judging.md; rig scripts/place/rigs/platina-rig-2026-11-11.json; brief lights-brief.md

rules.laser: none on this show: every scene laser null
rules.beams: XP-16R white/open only; heads patterns on XP-16R only (kinds acme-xp16r-bsw)
rules.hold: hold_s is total time on, fade inside it, never 0

scenes.title: Work light
scenes.intent: Plain white from the wash lamps and bars so crew can see; beams and everything else off.
scenes.notes: Single trigger; hold_s 1800 is the crew window, not a show time.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 0 WORK; safety rule B (one trigger, no chase)
scenes.why: Crew needs even white at a safe level; beams stay off so nobody is dazzled while focusing.

scenes.title: Doors, deep blue
scenes.intent: Doors open to a nearly black room: only the six floor K15 glow deep blue, bars dark. The room is held dark on purpose.
scenes.notes: Palette: deep blue #0a3ff0 from the deck grid-blue. Haze runs by hand (not a scene).
scenes.source: PHASE2_ARTIST_VIBE.md section 1: "dark room, one purple/magenta glow"; image1 deep blue haze in lights-brief.md section 1
scenes.why: Walk-in starts almost black with one cold colour, so the first magenta later reads as an event.

scenes.title: Wait, one pool
scenes.intent: Tension before he enters: everything dark except one narrow white column on his mark and a violet breath on the two centre towers.
scenes.notes: Tower 4 and 5 are the inner pair on each side (x -4.49 and +4.47), ASSUMED to read as centre.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 2 INTRO-WAIT; PHASE2_ARTIST_VIBE.md "one purple glow"
scenes.why: One lit spot in a dark room makes the audience look at the empty mark.

scenes.title: Entry, one beam
scenes.intent: His first step: only the centre beam, hard white, nothing else. No wash.
scenes.notes: XP-16R white/open only.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 3 ENTRY; PHASE1_BRIEF_FROM_CHAT.md (face visible, silhouette wish)
scenes.why: One hard column picks him out of black; any wash here would soften the entrance.

scenes.title: Magenta room
scenes.intent: The whole room one colour, magenta, low and heavy; towers and floor carry it, the over-stage wash fills the haze. No beams.
scenes.notes: Deck owner removed purple bars: here magenta is the whole room, not a purple bar look.
scenes.source: PHASE2_ARTIST_VIBE.md section 1 single art "purple screen glow"; deck glow-magenta #db01a8 (lights-brief.md section 3)
scenes.why: One saturated colour at a time lets the haze carry the volume; the slow breath keeps long holds alive without a change.

scenes.title: White pillars
scenes.intent: Seven over-stage beams drop straight down as white columns in the haze, the room around them magenta-dark: the beams are the architecture.
scenes.notes: Beams stay at home aim (straight down); no head pattern, so no audience-eye risk (rule D).
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 1 image3/image4 (beam fans from above); deck magenta lights-brief.md section 3
scenes.why: Static vertical beams in haze read as stage architecture and cost no motion; the holds stay calm.

scenes.title: SILHOUETTE: BACKLIGHT
scenes.intent: Front dark: K10 off. Backlight from the floor row K15 and the outer towers; background colour breathes magenta to ice-blue on the towers as the screen changes behind him.
scenes.notes: K15 floor row at z 0.13 per rig-report.md items table.
scenes.source: PHASE1_BRIEF_FROM_CHAT.md line 15 'only the silhouette visible while the background changes'
scenes.why: With no front light the body is a cut-out; keeping the towers colour moving shows a changing background without a second source. MERGE: floor K15 capped 0.5 (was 0.8): they pass the screen face by 0.08 m.

scenes.title: Red pressure
scenes.intent: Hard verse: all red, verticals only. Towers red, floor red low, five beams as a white X from above. One colour, no wash from the front.
scenes.notes: Red is a slow breathe at 50 bpm, no flash (rule A). heads on the XP-16R need the kinds check fixed in looks_from_scenes (ASSUMED).
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 5 and image3 (red base, five white beams X); deck signal red #e01020
scenes.why: Red towers with white crossing beams is the exact picture the team drew; steady red, no flashing.

scenes.title: VERSE: WORDS RED
scenes.intent: Hard verse with words on screen in #ff1a1a: floor K15 and tower bars go red to meet the words, K10 washes drop to near dark, white beams cut through the red.
scenes.notes: No red flash: breathe 35 bpm, rule A.
scenes.source: words/platina-words-demo2.mp4.txt line 3 'colour #ff1a1a'; loops/spec.json 'static-grey' c1 #e01020
scenes.why: The only saturated colour on a dark stage is the same red as the words, so the text and the room are the same signal; slow breathing avoids red flashing. MERGE: kinds typo acme-xp16r-bsw fixed to the patch id.

scenes.title: Freeze before the drop
scenes.intent: Everything falls to nothing in half a second and holds: one cold white beam on him and a dim white floor. No motion. Screen freezes with it.
scenes.notes: Reusable cue: the operator fires it before each of the three drops. No flash.
scenes.source: PHASE1_BRIEF_FROM_CHAT.md chat 2856/2862 "перед дропом изображение замирает"
scenes.why: A real drop needs a contrast to land on: a hold in near-dark makes the next hit feel twice as large.

scenes.title: Drop hit, white
scenes.intent: One hit: all wash lamps, bars and beams white for a moment, then it is the next scene. A single hit, no repeat.
scenes.notes: Reusable cue, hold 1.5 s total, then straight into the drop colour. Wash cap 0.8.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 9 DROP-WHITE and rule A
scenes.why: A one-beat white wall followed by colour is the standard drop and is within the 3 per second limit.

scenes.title: Drop A, magenta flood
scenes.intent: Drop one: the wash lamps flood magenta full, towers magenta, floor magenta. A wall of colour from above.
scenes.notes: Drop A is a flood from above; drops B and C differ in structure on purpose.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 10 DROP-MAGENTA; image4 magenta haze with fanned blue-white beams
scenes.why: Magenta is the deck colour, so screen and room hit together as one picture; the pump is slower than 2 per second.

scenes.title: Ice line
scenes.intent: Cool verse: only the towers, thin ice-blue, and a deep blue floor. Dark above.
scenes.notes: Moving mode sine on y: a slow rise through the towers, 30 bpm.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 3 grid-blue #4da6ff / #0a3ff0, section 5 scene 6
scenes.why: Vertical ice lines with no top light echo the line-art screen and give the verse air.

scenes.title: VERSE: GLITCH GREY
scenes.intent: Screen is grey/black glitch with red text: lights go to white and grey, only the words colour red on two towers; beams straight down.
scenes.notes: Sparkle at 90 bpm on bars: ASSUMED under 3 flashes per s per bar.
scenes.source: PHASE1_BRIEF_FROM_CHAT.md line 34 'IMG_1277 = grey glitch/pixel video with red text'; PHASE2_ARTIST_VIBE.md §3 B-glitch-freeze
scenes.why: Desaturated light with one red accent matches the team's own reference frame and keeps the red clearly smaller than half the room. MERGE: B had sparkle 90 bpm = 10 flashes/s (scenes_flash.cjs OVER); now breathe 30 bpm.

scenes.title: Slow part, one voice
scenes.intent: The quiet song: one narrow white column on him, floor violet at a whisper, the centre towers barely lit. Nothing else.
scenes.notes: No CO2 here (rule E). Long hold on purpose.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 13 SLOW PART; PHASE2_ARTIST_VIBE.md "playful-ironic, dark room"
scenes.why: Dropping to a single beam gives the quiet song its hush and rests the eye before the encore push.

scenes.title: Build, rising ice
scenes.intent: The riser: the towers rise from nothing to full ice blue over 12 seconds; wash joins late.
scenes.notes: Short scene; the fade_s is the build, hold_s 6 is the total on time at full.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 14 BUILD; deck grid-blue
scenes.why: One long fade from black is a clean build with no flicker and no strobe.

scenes.title: Drop B, red verticals
scenes.intent: Drop two: wash dark, towers red hard, a white X of five beams. The drop is narrow and vertical, not a flood.
scenes.notes: Chase 90 bpm, under 3 per second (rule A); no large red flashing. heads kinds check ASSUMED fixed.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 11 DROP-RED and image3 (red + white X); deck signal red #e01020
scenes.why: A bar chase at 90 bpm bottom to top with white crossing beams gives the hard-hitting look in a different shape from drop A.

scenes.title: Drop C, white cathedral
scenes.intent: Drop three: all twelve beams drop white as columns, towers ice then white alternating by tower, wash dark. A cathedral of beams.
scenes.notes: Beams 8-12 aim down from the audience-side truss, PROPOSED places (rig-report). Pingpong 60 bpm, no flash.
scenes.source: PHASE2_ARTIST_VIBE.md section 3 (flat colour screen, white glowing body); lights-brief.md image4 seven blue-white beams
scenes.why: Twelve beams standing in haze with a slow side-to-side bar is the third distinct drop: architecture instead of colour.

scenes.title: Encore wall
scenes.intent: Final push: wash magenta, towers alternate magenta and ice by tower, all twelve beams wide.
scenes.notes: Pump 72 bpm, under 3 per second.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 15 ENCORE; deck magenta + ice
scenes.why: The only scene with two colours at full strength, so the last push is clearly the biggest.

scenes.title: Bow, white thanks
scenes.intent: All white, face-lit from above and from the floor, beams off so no one is dazzled. His face is visible.
scenes.notes: Beams off, not tilted (the tilt can not be proven).
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 16 BOW and rule C; PHASE1_BRIEF_FROM_CHAT.md (face visible)
scenes.why: After a dark room, white at last is the thank-you; beams stay off for audience comfort.

scenes.title: Blackout
scenes.intent: Instant dark. One part at level zero stands for all.
scenes.notes: All parts off; hazers not touched.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md rule B (a blackout on one trigger) and scene 17
scenes.why: A clean cut to black marks the end before the house comes up.

scenes.title: House
scenes.intent: Walk-out: plain white, half level from the over-stage wash. Nothing else.
scenes.notes: Deck owner removed amber: plain white.
scenes.source: lights-brief.md section 5 scene 18 HOUSE
scenes.why: Even white so people leave safely; no warm amber is available or allowed.
